scope: native A1-B6 repository signals emitted by scoreRepoWithPublicCejel; operator-ingested findings and opt-in domain packs are excluded

definitions.canEmitEvidencePath: At least one executable native collector branch can construct a WitanEvidencePointer with path and place it in positiveEvidence or a finding.
definitions.findingPathCapable: At least one executable native collector branch can place a path-bearing WitanEvidencePointer in criterion.findings[].evidence.
definitions.cited: The dual-control predicate at Alfred runner commit 28fb2365dd1fa4952f63b2d1506cf248d31148c0 requires criterion.findings[].evidence.path to equal the defect-file path exactly.

criteria.codeEvidence: evidenceForRelative creates test/config/coverage paths; scheduled-health and authenticated-absence findings construct or reuse those path pointers
evidenceForRelative/evidenceForRelativeAtLine create secret, data-layer, and isolation paths; committed-secret findings cite the measured match path
evidenceForRelative creates deploy/readiness paths; the missing-automation finding reuses firstEvidence
evidenceForRelative creates manifest/lock/update paths and dependency findings construct manifest paths
evidenceForRelative creates claim-source/implementation paths; the reconciliation-gap finding reuses firstEvidence
collectRepoSignals always builds repository-scan B1 as not_applicable; buildNotApplicableSignal returns empty positiveEvidence and findings
evidenceForRelative creates workflow/template/review-gate paths; the collector always returns findings: []
evidenceForRelative creates package-script/workflow paths; the collector always returns findings: []
evidenceForRelative creates audit/changelog paths; the measured collector branch returns findings: []
collectRepoSignals always builds repository-scan B5 as not_applicable; buildNotApplicableSignal returns empty positiveEvidence and findings
evidenceForRelative creates governance/gate paths and ungated-escalation findings construct executable-file paths
